sections.description_of_the_ingredients:
1. Gomutra (cow urine) 

 It is a potent Ayurvedic bioactive liquid known for its detoxifying, antimicrobial, and metabolism-enhancing properties. It helps reduce excess fat accumulation (Medovriddhi) by improving fat metabolism and supporting digestive fire (Agni). Gomutra effectively controls foul-smelling sweat (Durgandhita Sveda) by balancing Pitta and Kapha doshas and eliminates toxins causing swelling (Shotha). It soothes liver and abdominal pain (Yakrit and Udar Shoola), purifies the blood (Rakta Vikar), helps manage low-grade fever (Mand Jwara), and supports urinary health by regulating disorders like Prameha. 
 Method Of Preparation 

 Take 20 parts of Gomutra (cow urine) and place it in the traditional distillation apparatus (Nadika yantra) 
 Collect about 10 parts of the ark (distillate) 

 Medicinal Properties 

 Detoxifies the body, reduces excess fat (Medohara), and purifies the blood (Raktashodhaka). 
 Stimulates digestion and metabolism (Deepana-Pachana) for better nutrient assimilation. 
 Acts as an anti-inflammatory (Shothahara) and helps reduce low-grade fever (Jwarahara).

 Reference : Ayurveda Sar Sangrah, Page number – 647 
 Abstract 
 In Ayurvedic medicine, Medohar Ark is a time-honored liquid formulation known for its therapeutic action on fat metabolism and systemic detoxification. Prepared through the distillation of Gomutra in a traditional distillation apparatus (Nadika yantra). This Ark works by stimulating digestive fire (Agni), promoting metabolic clarity, and aiding in the elimination of accumulated toxins (Ama). It is especially beneficial in conditions arising from Kapha aggravation, such as excess body weight, swelling, and low digestive strength. Its use extends to managing liver discomfort, blood impurities, low-grade fevers, and urinary imbalances, thereby supporting holistic wellness through natural purification. 
 Introduction 
 Medohar Ark is a classical Ayurvedic herbal distillate prepared primarily from Gomutra (cow urine) using traditional distillation methods. It is renowned for its effectiveness in managing obesity (Medovriddhi) and related metabolic disorders, along with detoxifying properties that support liver function and blood health. This formulation helps in reducing foul-smelling sweat, swelling, mild fever, and urinary disorders, making it a versatile remedy in Ayurveda. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Gomutra (cow urine) 
 
 Description Of The Ingredients 
 1. Gomutra (cow urine) 
 
 It is a potent Ayurvedic bioactive liquid known for its detoxifying, antimicrobial, and metabolism-enhancing properties. It helps reduce excess fat accumulation (Medovriddhi) by improving fat metabolism and supporting digestive fire (Agni). Gomutra effectively controls foul-smelling sweat (Durgandhita Sveda) by balancing Pitta and Kapha doshas and eliminates toxins causing swelling (Shotha). It soothes liver and abdominal pain (Yakrit and Udar Shoola), purifies the blood (Rakta Vikar), helps manage low-grade fever (Mand Jwara), and supports urinary health by regulating disorders like Prameha. 
 Method Of Preparation 
 
 Take 20 parts of Gomutra (cow urine) and place it in the traditional distillation apparatus (Nadika yantra) 
 Collect about 10 parts of the ark (distillate) 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 
 Detoxifies the body, reduces excess fat (Medohara), and purifies the blood (Raktashodhaka). 
 Stimulates digestion and metabolism (Deepana-Pachana) for better nutrient assimilation. 
 Acts as an anti-inflammatory (Shothahara) and helps reduce low-grade fever (Jwarahara). 
 
 Indications 
 
 Medovriddhi (Obesity) 
 Durgandhita Sveda (Foul-smelling sweat) 
 Shotha (Inflammation) 
 Yakrit Shoola (Liver colic) 
 Udar Shoola (Abdominal colic) 
 Rakta Vikar (Blood disorders) 
 Mand jwara (Low-grade fever) 
 Urinary disorders (Prameha) 
 
 Dosage 
 10 ml – 40 ml 
 Contraindication 
 
 This herbal formulation does not have any side effects. 
 Pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and children below 5 years should consult a healthcare provider before using this herbal formulation. 
 
 Conclusion 
 Medohar Ark is an effective Ayurvedic preparation for managing obesity and its related systemic complications. Its detoxifying and metabolism-enhancing properties support liver and blood health, making it valuable in treating chronic conditions like swelling, foul-smelling sweat, and mild fever. With its traditional preparation and natural ingredients, Medohar Ark remains a safe and trusted remedy in Ayurvedic therapeutics.
